description: Canonical lifecycle RECORD — the Part A / Part B interface contract. Part A (guardrails) emits records; Part B (self-improvement) reads them. There is exactly one record vocabulary; Part B must never define a second one.
invariants: decision 'deny' is only valid on a gate-class event
an observe-class event reports decision 'note' and can never deny
the event id MUST exist in events.json
the action verb MUST exist in actions.schema.json
